confidence_reasons: mean valid-pixel share of the observations used: 100%
0% of the footprint is uncertain (cloud or gaps) and excluded
limitations: Spatial resolution is about 91 m per pixel; no positional-noise filter is applied to this classification product, so single-pixel changes are kept.
Only Jan were compared so that seasons match; other months were not used for the start/end maps.
Fewer than five yearly composites exist, so the year-to-year scatter test could not be applied.
The data describe where and how much built-up area extent changed. They cannot, by themselves, establish why.
what_was_analysed: Same-season composites of 2000 (1 observations) and 2020 (1 observations), using only Jan so seasons match. A pixel counts as built-up area if it is built-up area in at least 50% of its valid observations; 0 ha (0%) were uncertain and excluded.
